import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

def trans(xyz=(0,0,0), rpy=(0,0,0)):
    x,y,z=xyz; r,p,yaw=rpy
    Rx=np.array([[1,0,0],[0,np.cos(r),-np.sin(r)],[0,np.sin(r),np.cos(r)]])
    Ry=np.array([[np.cos(p),0,np.sin(p)],[0,1,0],[-np.sin(p),0,np.cos(p)]])
    Rz=np.array([[np.cos(yaw),-np.sin(yaw),0],[np.sin(yaw),np.cos(yaw),0],[0,0,1]])
    A=np.eye(4); A[:3,:3]=Rz@Ry@Rx; A[:3,3]=xyz; return A

def rotz(a):
    A=np.eye(4); A[:3,:3]=[[np.cos(a),-np.sin(a),0],[np.sin(a),np.cos(a),0],[0,0,1]]; return A
links=[((0,0,.333),(0,0,0)),((0,0,0),(-np.pi/2,0,0)),((0,-.316,0),(np.pi/2,0,0)),((.0825,0,0),(np.pi/2,0,0)),((-.0825,.384,0),(-np.pi/2,0,0)),((0,0,0),(np.pi/2,0,0)),((.088,0,0),(np.pi/2,0,0))]
BASE=np.array([-.234685,-.170181,.687302])
def fk(q):
    A=np.eye(4)
    for i in range(7): A=A@trans(*links[i])@rotz(q[i])
    A=A@trans((0,0,.107))
    A[:3,3]+=BASE
    return A

def ik(pos, start, R=None):
    if R is None: R=fk(start)[:3,:3]
    def fun(q):
        A=fk(q)
        dr=Rotation.from_matrix(R.T@A[:3,:3]).as_rotvec()
        return np.r_[ (A[:3,3]-pos)*4, dr*0.8, (q-start)*.015 ]
    lo=np.array([-2.9,-1.8,-2.9,-3.0,-2.9,-.1,-2.9]); hi=np.array([2.9,1.8,2.9,-.05,2.9,3.7,2.9])
    res=least_squares(fun,start,bounds=(lo,hi),max_nfev=300)
    return res.x, np.linalg.norm(fk(res.x)[:3,3]-pos), np.linalg.norm(R.T@fk(res.x)[:3,:3]-np.eye(3))
if __name__=='__main__':
    q=np.array([0,-1.047584,.003174,-2.639955,-.004409,1.535637,-2.319998])
    print('FK',fk(q)[:3,3])
    for p in [[.15,.29,1.15],[.15,.29,.99],[.30,-.05,1.15],[.30,-.05,.99]]:
        q2,e,o=ik(np.array(p),q)
        print(p, q2.round(4), 'err',e,o)
